data.name: Oona
data.gender_notes: Oona is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Irish word 'oin', meaning 'mist' or 'cloud'. The name Oona has been associated with the mystical and unknown. In Irish folklore, Oonas were fairy women who could foretell the future. The name Oona carries the meaning “Mystery” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Oona usually hope their child will grow to embody mystery and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of mystery and the unknown.
data.etymology: Oona belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mystery.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oona total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
